elements.description: One image while it's generated: queued, a picture that sharpens as it progresses with the step and time left, then the image – or why it failed.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: Names the card – what the image is for

properties.name: status
properties.description: Where the job is: "queued", "generating", "done", "failed" or "cancelled"

properties.name: position
properties.description: The image's place in the queue while queued – 1 is next

properties.name: progress
properties.description: How far along it is, 0 to 1, while generating; left out, the bar sweeps

properties.name: step
properties.description: The step the model is on, while generating

properties.name: steps
properties.description: How many steps the job takes

properties.name: eta
properties.description: Seconds left, when the model estimates it

properties.name: phase
properties.description: What it's doing while generating, in a word – "Generating", "Refining", "Upscaling"

properties.name: src
properties.description: The finished image's URL – a data: URL works too. Shown when done

properties.name: alt
properties.description: What the finished image shows, for people who can't see it

properties.name: preview
properties.description: An intermediate image the model sent, shown blurred while generating – the blur falls as the progress rises

properties.name: error
properties.description: Why it failed, in a few words

properties.name: prompt
properties.description: The prompt the image comes from

properties.name: model
properties.description: The model's name, shown as a chip under the prompt

properties.name: size
properties.description: The image's size, shown as a chip – "1024 × 1536"

properties.name: aspectRatio
properties.description: The frame's shape, so nothing jumps when the image arrives: "1:1", "16:9", "3:4" …

properties.name: filename
properties.description: File name for Download – from the heading by default

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: Whether a long prompt shows in full

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Rename any of the words, over the defaults

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-cancel
events.description: Cancel while queued or generating. Cancelable: unless prevented, the card shows as cancelled ({ status }: ImageGenerationCancel)

events.name: tc-retry
events.description: Try again on a failed image; the app starts the job again ({ prompt }: ImageGenerationRequest)

events.name: tc-regenerate
events.description: Regenerate on a done image, or Start again after a cancel; the app starts a new job ({ prompt }: ImageGenerationRequest)

events.name: tc-download
events.description: Download on a done image. Cancelable: unless prevented, the image is saved ({ src, filename }: ImageGenerationDownload)

events.name: tc-copy-prompt
events.description: Copy prompt. Cancelable: unless prevented, the prompt is copied ({ prompt }: ImageGenerationRequest)

events.name: tc-expanded-change
events.description: Show more or Show less on a long prompt. Cancelable – prevented, `expanded` stays as it was ({ expanded }: ImageGenerationExpandedChange)

functions.name: defaultImageGenerationLabels
functions.description: The words used when the page gives none

functions.name: parseAspectRatio
functions.description: "16:9", "16/9", "1.5" → a CSS aspect-ratio; square when it can't be read

functions.name: formatEta
functions.description: Seconds left in words: "about 12 s left", "about 2 min left", "a moment left"

props.name: title
props.description: Names the card – what the image is for

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether a long prompt shows in full. Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether a long prompt starts in full when uncontrolled

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Show more or Show less on a long prompt

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Cancel while queued or generating – stop the job. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the card as it is until your status arrives

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again on a failed image – start the job again

props.name: onRegenerate
props.description: Regenerate on a done image, or Start again after a cancel – start a new job

props.name: onDownload
props.type: (src: string, filename: string, event: Event) => void
props.description: Download on a done image; it's saved unless you call event.preventDefault()

props.name: onCopyPrompt
props.description: Copy prompt; it's copied unless you call event.preventDefault()

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
